about.title: About
about.setupTourDesc: Walk back through array setup, cache, and the Apps/Docker/LXC/Notifications tour.
about.rebootDesc: Reboots the whole host, not just this app. The array stops and unmounts cleanly first (the normal shutdown sequence - same as if you ran this at the console), then Docker, LXC, Samba, and NFS all stop too. Everything comes back on its own once the host finishes booting; this page reconnects automatically, no need to refresh by hand.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.languageDesc: Only English is available today - more languages may be added later.

array.title: Array
array.turboWriteDesc: Faster writes but at the expense of more power draw and all drives must be spun up on HDDs. Best for large transfters, rebuilds, and parity checks.
array.spinDownDesc: Spin down HDD data and parity disks after this long with no activity. Programmed directly on each drive - SSDs and the boot disk are never affected.
array.reloadDriverDesc: Resets stale internal counters - doesn't change array disks.
array.reloadDriverPromptDesc: Resets stale internal counters - doesn't change array disks. May leave the array briefly down; let it finish.

cache.title: Cache
cache.useCacheDesc: Writes to the cache mirror first. A scheduled mover then drains cache onto the array below. Speeds up read/writes.
cache.autoMoverDesc: Moves everything on cache onto the array.
cache.runMoverDesc1: Moves cache onto the array now.
cache.runMoverDesc2: A file that's currently open (e.g. by a running Docker container) is skipped rather than failing the whole run.
cache.runMoverDesc3: Stop anything actively using cache-hosted paths first for a complete move.

dockerLxc.title: Docker & LXC Storage
dockerLxc.dockerStorageDesc: Location of docker system and image file storage.

shares.title: Pools
shares.minFreeSpaceDesc: When a pool spans multiple disks, mergerfs won't pick a disk with less free space than this for a new file. Its own default is 4GB.
shares.minFreeSpaceError: Enter a non-negative whole number of MB.

backups.title: Local Backups
backups.autoBackupDesc1: Backs up Samba/NFS config, this app's settings/pools/shares/users, the array superblock, and Docker config.
backups.passwordPlaceholderExisting: Leave blank to keep the current password
backups.retainError: Enter a positive whole number for how many backups to keep, or check "Keep all backups forever".
backups.destDiskError: Pick a disk for the destination.
backups.encryptPasswordError: Enter a password to enable encryption.
backups.backUpNowTooltip: Writes a config backup into the destination directory above, right now.
backups.downloadCopyTooltip: Downloads a config backup straight to this device's browser downloads - doesn't touch the array or its destination directory.

recovery.title: Recovery
recovery.restoreConfigDesc: Bring back this app's settings/pools/shares/users, Samba/NFS config, and (only while the array is currently blank) the array superblock, from a previously-saved config backup.
recovery.recoverArrayDesc: Restores only the array superblock - disk assignments and parity configuration - out of a config backup, leaving every other setting untouched. Only takes effect while this array currently has nothing assigned; stop and clear the array first if it isn't already blank.
recovery.importDescPrefix: Migrate the disks and configuration from a previous NonRAID or Unraid array in directly, using its own
recovery.importDescSuffix: superblock file rather than a config backup.
recovery.recoverArrayWizardTitle: Recover the array from an uploaded file

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.appriseToggleDesc: Master switch for the Apprise channel below - the in-app bell/toast (Webui column) has no master switch of its own, it's controlled purely per-event.
notifications.targetUrlsDescSuffix: , space or newline separated (e.g. mailto://, discord://, pushover://).

security.title: Security
security.trustProxyDesc: Only enable if a reverse proxy is the sole way to reach this backend (it's firewalled off from any other direct access) and that proxy always sets/overwrites X-Forwarded-Proto/Host/For itself - otherwise a direct client could spoof those headers to fake an HTTPS connection or dodge login/TOTP rate limiting. Once enabled, the session cookie's Secure flag and passkey RP ID/origin are detected from the request automatically, no need to set them by hand.
security.trustProxyAddressDesc: Optional - an IP, CIDR range, or hostname for the reverse proxy itself. Only forwarded headers arriving via this address are trusted; left blank, any hop is trusted once the toggle above is on. Multiple addresses can be comma-separated.
security.changePasswordDesc: Also signs out every other session.
security.stepUpDesc: Changing your password signs you out of every session, including this one.
